title: The part window title shows Active or Inactive beside the close X
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILL-01) is stocked at {Location-A} and listed on the Active tab.
  • Inactive part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PILL-02) is stocked at {Location-A} and listed on the Inactive tab.
custom_steps:
1. Go to Parts → Inventory and click New Inventory Part.
  2. Click the X at the right end of the title row.
  3. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click the X.
  6. Click the Inactive tab.
  7. Type {Part-B} in the search.
  8. Click the {Part-B} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the window is titled "New Inventory Part". A thin line runs under the title row, and the close X sits at its right end. No status pill shows.
  • Step 2: the window closes.
  • Step 4: the window is titled "Edit Inventory Part", with a thin line under the title row and a green pill reading "Active" beside the close X.
  • Step 5: the window closes.
  • Step 8: the title row shows a grey pill reading "Inactive" beside the close X.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R1, S13-R2, S13-R3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Inventory Part opens), board 2.1 (The part as it stands), board 3.6 (Opening the inactive part), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R1: “The dialog is titled "New Inventory Part" when creating a part and "Edit Inventory Part" when editing one.”
  • S13-R2: “The title row has a thin line under it, and the close X at its right end.”
  • S13-R3: “When editing, the title row shows the part's saved status as a pill beside the close X: "Active" in green, or "Inactive" in grey.”
